status: DRAFT: Curriculum Bot checks facts + reading level before ship; other 7 languages filled by Build per brief

grass.name: Grass
grass.what: Grass on top of soil. Break it and you get Dirt.

dirt.name: Dirt
dirt.what: Soil: tiny bits of rock mixed with old plant matter.

stone.name: Stone
stone.what: Plain rock. Most of the underground is stone.

slate.name: Slate
slate.what: A dark rock that splits into flat sheets.

coal.name: Coal Ore
coal.what: Coal formed from plants in ancient forests and marshes. They were buried and squeezed for millions of years.

sand.name: Sand
sand.what: Sand is mostly tiny grains of quartz. Bake 2 in the Oven for Glass.

gravel.name: Gravel
gravel.what: Small rounded stones, often found in river beds.

brickRed.name: Red Brick
brickRed.what: Baked clay bricks. Strong when you push on them.

planks.name: Planks
planks.what: Boards sawn from a log. 1 Log makes 4.

log.name: Log
log.what: A piece of tree trunk. The rings show its age.

leaves.name: Leaves
leaves.what: Leaves make food for the tree from sunlight. Sometimes a Berry falls out.

woolBlue.name: Blue Cloth Block
woolBlue.what: A soft block of dyed cloth.

woolGreen.name: Green Cloth Block
woolGreen.what: A soft block of dyed cloth.

woolRed.name: Red Cloth Block
woolRed.what: A soft block of dyed cloth.

woolTan.name: Tan Cloth Block
woolTan.what: A soft block of undyed cloth.

ice.name: Ice
ice.what: Frozen water. In Bertopia it does not slide.

redSand.name: Red Sand
redSand.what: Sand stained red by iron. Bake it for Red Brick.

glass.name: Glass
glass.what: Sand melted and cooled until you can see through it.

coreplate.name: Coreplate
coreplate.what: The floor of the world at y -64. It never breaks.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.what: A table for making things from wood, cloth and stone.

oven.name: Oven
oven.what: Bakes food and turns sand into glass.

vend.name: Vending Counter
vend.what: Sells your goods to townsfolk while you play.

storeCounter.name: Store Counter
storeCounter.what: The town store. Restock things you have already found.

bunk.name: Bunk
bunk.what: Tap it to set your home spot.

box.name: Box
box.what: Holds 18 stacks. Two side by side make a Double Box.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.what: A grass whose seeds are ground into flour.

reed.name: Reed
reed.what: A tall plant that grows by water. Here it gives sugar.

door.name: Wood Door
door.what: A door made from 6 Planks. Tap to open.

doorGlass.name: Glass Door
doorGlass.what: A door with glass panes. Tap to open.

doorMetal.name: Metal Door
doorMetal.what: A steel door. Only a button, lever or power opens it.

doorSliding.name: Sliding Lab Door
doorSliding.what: Slides open when powered and someone walks up.

lever.name: Lever
lever.what: Flip it to turn a circuit on or off.

pushButton.name: Push Button
pushButton.what: Press it for 1.5 seconds of power.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.what: Melts ore into metal. Its Forge tab shapes the metal.

fabricator.name: Fabricator
fabricator.what: Builds anything with a battery, silicon or a chip. Runs on charge.

ironOre.name: Iron Ore
ironOre.what: Rusty rock full of iron. Most metal people use is iron.

copperOre.name: Copper Ore
copperOre.what: Rock with copper in it. Copper carries electricity, so wires use it.

zincOre.name: Zinc Ore
zincOre.what: Rock with zinc. Zinc coats steel so it does not rust.

lantern.name: LED Lantern
lantern.what: A battery light. Tap for Low, Medium or High.

charger.name: Charger
charger.what: Like a wall outlet: it always gives power.

glowPebble.name: Glow Pebble
glowPebble.what: A tiny glow. A little chemical makes a short light.

glowStick.name: Glow Stick
glowStick.what: A chemical light. Once it is used up, it is done.

jumboGlow.name: Jumbo Glow
jumboGlow.what: A big glow stick. A dye takes the energy and picks the color.

coldGlowVial.name: Cold Glow Vial
coldGlowVial.what: Cold slows the reaction, so it glows longer.

glowMoss.name: Glow Moss
glowMoss.what: A cave moss that glows. Glowing fungi are real. No real moss makes its own light, so this is a Bertopia idea.

cornPlant.name: Corn Bush
cornPlant.what: Corn is a grain. Some plastics are made from corn.

solarPanel.name: Solar Panel
solarPanel.what: Turns sunlight into power. Its cell runs 2 strips through the night.

glowStrip.name: LED Glow Strip
glowStrip.what: A thin light that uses 1 charge a minute.

copperWireBlock.name: Copper Wire
copperWireBlock.what: Carries power from makers to users. Glows teal when powered.

water.name: Water
water.what: In Bertopia water stays still and never floods a build.

tinOre.name: Tin Ore
tinOre.what: Dark crystals of cassiterite, the main tin ore. About 9 parts copper to 1 part tin makes bronze.

quartzOre.name: Quartz Vein
quartzOre.what: White crystals of silica, the same stuff as most sand.

quartzSand.name: Quartz Sand
quartzSand.what: Dune sand with quartz grains you can collect.

clay.name: Clay
clay.what: Soft, sticky earth found by water. Bake it into Brick.

boundaryClay.name: Boundary Clay
boundaryClay.what: A thin gray stripe of clay. It is left from a space rock that hit long ago.

silverOre.name: Silver Ore
silverOre.what: No metal reflects light better than silver.

goldOre.name: Gold Ore
goldOre.what: Gold is found in quartz veins in hard rock, and as flakes in river gravel.

graphiteOre.name: Graphite
graphiteOre.what: Soft, shiny carbon. It formed when heat and pressure changed rocks that held old plant and animal remains.

pannedGravel.name: Panned Gravel
pannedGravel.what: Gravel you already panned. It has nothing left to find.

molten.name: Molten Metal
molten.what: Metal so hot it flows. Here it bounces you back to safety.

saltCrust.name: Salt Crust
saltCrust.what: Salt left behind where an old lake dried up.

blackSand.name: Black Sand
blackSand.what: Beach sand rich in heavy, dark minerals. Some of them hold titanium.

bauxite.name: Bauxite
bauxite.what: Red-brown earth rich in aluminum. It forms where rock weathers in warm, wet places.

ilmeniteOre.name: Ilmenite Ore
ilmeniteOre.what: A heavy black mineral. It holds titanium.

platinumOre.name: Platinum Ore
platinumOre.what: One of the rarest metals in the crust. Only deep under Emberdeep.

basalt.name: Basalt
basalt.what: Dark rock made when lava cools.

snowGrass.name: Snowy Grass
snowGrass.what: Soil with a cap of snow.

cottonBush.name: Cotton Bush
cottonBush.what: Cotton fluff is plant fiber. 3 Cotton spin into 1 Cloth.

flowerBush.name: Flowers
flowerBush.what: Flowers feed bees and butterflies. 1 Flower makes 2 Paint dabs.

saltPan.name: Salt Pan
saltPan.what: Sun dries seawater. The salt stays behind.

cabinet.name: Cabinet
cabinet.what: 24 slots behind a door you can lock.

glassCabinet.name: Glass Cabinet
glassCabinet.what: 24 slots, lockable, shows its top 4 things.

sign.name: Sign
sign.what: A label for a Box or a path.

itemTube.name: Item Tube
itemTube.what: A clear tube that moves items 2 blocks a second.

poweredTube.name: Powered Tube
poweredTube.what: A tube with copper rings: 6 blocks a second.

filterTube.name: Filter Tube
filterTube.what: Only lets in items that match its rule.

extractor.name: Extractor
extractor.what: Pulls a stack out of storage every 2 seconds.

sorter.name: Sorter
sorter.what: Sends items down up to 4 outputs by rule.

networkCore.name: Network Core
networkCore.what: The brain of a storage network. 1 per player.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.what: A search engine for your stuff.

storageLink.name: Storage Link
storageLink.what: Snaps onto a Box so the network can see inside.

teleportPad.name: Teleport Pad
teleportPad.what: Sends items (never people) to its partner pad.

droneDock.name: Drone Dock
droneDock.what: Charges your Delivery Drone and sends it off.

networkPad.name: Network Pad
networkPad.what: A teleport pad that talks to your network.

bounceBlock.name: Bounce Block
bounceBlock.what: A spring pad. It stores energy when you land and gives it back.

discoFloor.name: Disco Floor
discoFloor.what: Lights up where you step. Smooth fades, never strobe.

noteBlock.name: Tone Block
noteBlock.what: Tap to raise the pitch. The block under it picks the instrument.

jukebox.name: Jukebox
jukebox.what: Plays Music Discs, including your own DJ Berty songs.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.what: A squash that ripens in autumn.

jackOLantern.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
jackOLantern.what: A carved pumpkin with an LED inside, never a flame.

cornStalks.name: Corn Stalks
cornStalks.what: Dried corn stalks tied in a bundle.

leafPile.name: Leaf Pile
leafPile.what: Autumn leaves raked into a pile.

appleCrate.name: Apple Crate
appleCrate.what: A wooden crate of autumn apples.

ghostLight.name: Friendly Ghost Light
ghostLight.what: A soft, smiling ghost-shaped LED light.

cobweb.name: Cobweb Deco
cobweb.what: A fake cobweb. It is just for looks.

marigold.name: Marigolds
marigold.what: Bright orange flowers that bloom from summer into autumn.

papelPicado.name: Papel Picado Banner
papelPicado.what: Bright paper banners with cut-out shapes.

marigoldPatternTile.name: Marigold Pattern Tile
marigoldPatternTile.what: A tile with a bright marigold flower pattern.

rangoliTile.name: Pattern Floor Tile
rangoliTile.what: A floor tile with a simple geometric pattern. Paint it any color.

stringLights.name: String Lights
stringLights.what: A strand of small LED lights.

labBench.name: Lab Bench
labBench.what: Where Wonder Lab gadgets and effects are made.

warpPad.name: Warp Pad
warpPad.what: A player-size pad you can warp to with a Warp Key.

sleepingBag.name: Sleeping Bag
sleepingBag.what: Tap to set where you come back.

crewBanner.name: Crew Banner
crewBanner.what: A shared spawn spot for your crew.

gameZoneFlag.name: Game Zone Flag
gameZoneFlag.what: Marks a play zone for Hide-and-Seek and mini-games.

workshopDoor.name: Workshop Door
workshopDoor.what: Teacher-flag door to the Build world.

draftingTable.name: Drafting Table
draftingTable.what: Read Blueprint Scrolls here to unlock new materials.

cleanBench.name: Clean Bench
cleanBench.what: A bench with no dust. You make the finest parts here.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.what: Polished silver behind glass reflects light.

dexShelf.name: Dex Shelf
dexShelf.what: A trophy for filling half the Bertodex.

bamboo.name: Bamboo Pole
bamboo.what: A light, hollow grass stem. Strong for its weight.

plywood.name: Plywood
plywood.what: Thin wood layers glued with the grain crossing.

cinderBlock.name: Cinder Block
cinderBlock.what: A hollow concrete block, like real building blocks.

concrete.name: Concrete
concrete.what: Strong when pushed, cracks when pulled.

tintedGlass.name: Tinted Glass
tintedGlass.what: Darker glass. It lets less light through, but you can still see through it.

frostedGlass.name: Frosted Glass
frostedGlass.what: Lets light through but blurs what is behind it.

overflowBox.name: Overflow Box
overflowBox.what: Holds what did not fit. Take-only, never deleted.

granite.name: Granite
granite.what: Speckled rock made from slowly cooled magma.

redSoil.name: Red Soil
redSoil.what: Soil weathered for a long time in a warm, wet climate.

spruceLog.name: Spruce-like Log
spruceLog.what: A tree that keeps its needles all winter.

seaWater.name: Sea Water
seaWater.what: Still seawater. A Salt Pan beside it makes salt.

hayBale.name: Hay Bale
hayBale.what: Dried grass pressed into a bale, used to feed animals.

gourds.name: Gourds
gourds.what: Gourds are cousins of pumpkins and squash, in many shapes.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.what: A straw figure farmers use to keep birds off crops.

batsDeco.name: Bat Garland
batsDeco.what: Paper bats. Real bats eat lots of insects at night.

carvedPumpkin.name: Carved Pumpkin
carvedPumpkin.what: A pumpkin with a face you carved yourself. An LED inside makes it glow.

spookySign.name: Spooky Sign
spookySign.what: A wooden sign with a bat cut-out. Write a friendly message on it.

harvestLantern.name: Autumn Lantern
harvestLantern.what: A hanging lantern with an LED glow, never a flame.

chair.name: Chair
chair.what: A seat for a table. Use it to sit; move to get up.

stool.name: Stool
stool.what: A seat with no back. Use it to sit; move to get up.

bench.name: Bench
bench.what: A long seat for 2. Use it to sit; move to get up.

table.name: Table
table.what: A table. Put chairs, stools or a bench next to it.

winterLights.name: Winter Lights
winterLights.what: LED string lights. Steady, or a slow twinkle when Motion is on. Never flashes.

giftBox.name: Gift Box Deco
giftBox.what: A wrapped box for decoration. It holds nothing.

snowPal.name: Snow Pal
snowPal.what: A friendly snow figure. It never melts here.

ornamentTile.name: Ornament Tile
ornamentTile.what: A tile with shiny round ornaments.

stripeBlock.name: Peppermint Stripe Block
stripeBlock.what: A red and white striped block.

woodTool.name: Wood Pick
woodTool.what: Mines every block 2× faster than a hand. Never wears out.

pan.name: Pan
pan.what: A wooden pan. Swirl river gravel to find heavy gold flakes.

berry.name: Berry
berry.what: A small fruit. Leaves sometimes drop one.

paintDab.name: Paint dab
paintDab.what: The first paints were made from colored earth called ochre. The color comes from pigments.

corn.name: Corn
corn.what: Corn kernels. Cook 2 in the Oven for Bioplastic.

cornSeed.name: Corn Seed
cornSeed.what: Plant it on Dirt or Grass.

bioplastic.name: Bioplastic
bioplastic.what: Some plastics are made from plants, like corn.

plasticTube.name: Plastic Tube
plasticTube.what: A clear tube for glow sticks and machines.

glowMix.name: Glow Mix
glowMix.what: The two chemicals of a glow stick, ready to react.

boosterDye.name: Booster Dye
boosterDye.what: Takes the reaction energy and glows. The dye picks the color.

glassVial.name: Glass Vial
glassVial.what: A small glass bottle. 1 Glass makes 2.

rawCopper.name: Raw Copper
rawCopper.what: Copper straight from the rock. Smelt it into an ingot.

copperWire.name: Copper Wire
copperWire.what: Thin copper wire. It carries power.

ironIngot.name: Iron Ingot
ironIngot.what: Smelted iron, ready to become steel.

steel.name: Steel
steel.what: Iron with a little carbon. Springs back until pushed too far.

bronzeIngot.name: Bronze Ingot
bronzeIngot.what: About 9 parts copper to 1 part tin, like real tin bronze.

silverIngot.name: Silver Ingot
silverIngot.what: Silver, smelted and ready to use.

goldFlake.name: Gold Flake
goldFlake.what: A tiny flake from a river. 9 make a Gold Nugget.

goldLeaf.name: Gold Leaf
goldLeaf.what: Gold beaten very thin. 1 Ingot makes 16.

quartz.name: Quartz
quartz.what: A clear crystal made of silicon and oxygen.

silicon.name: Silicon
silicon.what: Sand and quartz are silica. Heating them with carbon pulls out silicon.

batteryCell.name: Battery Cell
batteryCell.what: Put copper and zinc in a sour or salty liquid. That makes a simple battery.

spring.name: Spring
spring.what: Steel coiled so it springs back.

wireRope.name: Wire Rope
wireRope.what: Steel wires twisted together. Very strong when pulled, but floppy when pushed.

cottonSeed.name: Cotton Seed
cottonSeed.what: Plant it on Dirt or Grass.

salt.name: Salt
salt.what: Sodium chloride: the salt on food.

platinumGrain.name: Platinum Grain
platinumGrain.what: A grain of platinum from an Emberdeep river.

platinumIngot.name: Platinum Ingot
platinumIngot.what: Platinum melts at 1,768 °C, so it needs the Embercore upgrade.

alumina.name: Alumina
alumina.what: White powder made from bauxite. It takes a lot of power to make it into aluminum.

aluminumIngot.name: Aluminum Ingot
aluminumIngot.what: A light metal. It is common, but making it takes lots of electricity.

aluminumBeam.name: Aluminum Beam
aluminumBeam.what: In Bertopia it does a Steel Beam's job. Real aluminum is about a third as heavy as steel, but it bends more.

titaniumDioxide.name: Titanium Dioxide
titaniumDioxide.what: White powder refined from black sand.

titaniumIngot.name: Titanium Ingot
titaniumIngot.what: Titanium is not rare. It is hard to refine.

rhodiumSpeck.name: Rhodium Speck
rhodiumSpeck.what: One of the rarest metals. It stays shiny because air and water barely change it.

iridiumSpeck.name: Iridium Speck
iridiumSpeck.what: The rarest find of all. For its size, iridium is one of the two heaviest elements.

fob.name: Fob
fob.what: The fob sends a radio signal; the bot follows the strongest signal.

botH1.name: Berty's Bot H1
botH1.what: A little bot that follows you and carries your stuff.

deliveryDrone.name: Delivery Drone
deliveryDrone.what: Slow, cheap and visible. Carries 4 stacks.

petRock.name: Pet Rock
petRock.what: A rock has no motor. That is why it is so slow.

gravityHat.name: Gravity Hat
gravityHat.what: Gravity pulls everything down. The hat pushes back a little, for a little while.

musicDisc.name: Music Disc
musicDisc.what: Plays a song in a Jukebox.

warpKey.name: Warp Key
warpKey.what: Warps you to your own Warp Pad.

herbTonic.name: Herb Tonic
herbTonic.what: A plant drink for resting up.

medKit.name: Med Kit
medKit.what: First aid for you and your crew.

whistleBell.name: Whistle Bell
whistleBell.what: Calls your Pet Rock and Bot.

critterJar.name: Critter Jar
critterJar.what: Releases friendly critters for a while.

morphVial.name: Morph Vial
morphVial.what: Mimicry: copy the look of a block or critter.

fizzVial.name: Fizz Vial
fizzVial.what: A gas plus a liquid makes foam.

frostVial.name: Frost Vial
frostVial.what: Freezes still water so you can walk on it.

sparkRod.name: Spark Rod
sparkRod.what: Remote-powers your own circuit for a few seconds.

blueprintScroll.name: Blueprint Scroll
blueprintScroll.what: Read it at the Drafting Table. It unlocks a new material.

carvingTool.name: Carving Scoop
carvingTool.what: A safe scoop, not a knife. Use it on a Pumpkin to carve a face.

blueWhiteLights.name: Blue & White Lights
blueWhiteLights.what: A plain string of blue and soft-white LED bulbs.
blueWhiteLights.origin: Blue and white lights are hung for Hanukkah in many Jewish homes.

wovenMat.name: Woven Mat
wovenMat.what: A flat mat woven in red, black and green.
wovenMat.origin: Woven mats (mkeka) are laid out for Kwanzaa in many African American homes.

harvestBasket.name: Harvest Basket
harvestBasket.what: A basket of fruit and corn.
harvestBasket.origin: Fruit and corn are set out for Kwanzaa and at many harvest festivals.

redLantern.name: Red Lantern
redLantern.what: A round red paper lantern with a steady LED glow.
redLantern.origin: Red paper lanterns are hung for Lunar New Year in many East Asian homes.

paperDragon.name: Paper Dragon
paperDragon.what: A long, friendly paper dragon with a steady LED glow.
paperDragon.origin: Paper dragons are carried in Lunar New Year parades.

fanousLantern.name: Fanous Lantern
fanousLantern.what: A metal-and-glass lantern with geometric windows and an LED glow.
fanousLantern.origin: Fanous lanterns light streets during Ramadan in Egypt and nearby countries.

colourSplash.name: Color Splash Block
colourSplash.what: A block covered in bright paint splats.
colourSplash.origin: People throw colored powder at Holi, a spring festival from India.

springGreens.name: Spring Greens
springGreens.what: A dish of sprouted green grass.
springGreens.origin: Sprouted greens (sabzeh) are grown for Nowruz, the new year in Afghanistan, Iran and nearby countries.

kindnessHeart.name: Kindness Heart
kindnessHeart.what: A paper heart with flowers on it.
kindnessHeart.origin: Hearts are shared during Kindness Week.

solarFlower.name: Solar Flower
solarFlower.what: A flower that charges by day and glows softly at night.
solarFlower.origin: Solar Flowers celebrate Earth Day and clean energy.

imigongoTile.name: Imigongo Zigzag Tile
imigongoTile.what: A tile with black, white and red zigzags.
imigongoTile.origin: Imigongo is zigzag art from eastern Rwanda.

petrykivkaTile.name: Petrykivka Flower Tile
petrykivkaTile.what: A tile painted with bright flower sprays.
petrykivkaTile.origin: Petrykivka is a Ukrainian folk style of flower painting.

mesobBasket.name: Mesob Basket
mesobBasket.what: A tall woven basket with a lid.
mesobBasket.origin: A mesob is a woven table-basket from Eritrea and Ethiopia.
